input.command:
git branch --show-current && git add public/index.html public/app.js public/style.css && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Enlarge center column and move master goal under levels

"Earn all 3 badges to become a PhishSense Master" now sits centered under
the difficulty buttons with a trophy in front. The Masters card centers
its list and adds "Can you join them?" when there are only 1 or 2 Masters.

Bigger logo, title, name box and difficulty buttons. Columns are about
25/50/25, and the home screen fills the window down to the waves without
scrolling at 1920x1080 or 1366x768. Phones keep the stacked order.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git push origin New_Features 2>&1 | tail -3; git log --oneline -1
